title: Improve complete conditional κ to 0.00304153 via coupled P104 contacts
body:
This changes two coupled frame itineraries in Ali Romman's complete P104 candidate [#5545](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5545), raising its **conditional κ from 0.00304117 to 0.00304153**. Six ADDs and fifteen commuting SCALE chart annotations move; every scalar coefficient and its order remain identical.

The new local paid delta is `+2H1 −3H2 +H3 −H4 +H5`, repeated at all eighteen supplier invocations. Strict concavity proves a gain for every exponent in (0,1). All 735 arbitrary public inputs, all 527 productive helpers, all 743 endpoint rows and the eight owned lifetimes remain. The complete invoice still has **69,912 paid calls  / 12,814 productive fields**, rank surplus 760; no helper, query, restoration or ordinary work is omitted.

This is a different paid-path change from the existing single `H1+H5→H6` contact and its narrow repetition ceiling. No new general optimizer or global optimum is claimed. [PROOF.md](https://github.com/thu-nmrc/integer-mult-bounds/blob/codex/p104-joint-contact/research/p104-joint-contact/PROOF.md) gives the literal sites, all-positive-width typed implication, full price and limits; [SEARCH.md](https://github.com/thu-nmrc/integer-mult-bounds/blob/codex/p104-joint-contact/research/p104-joint-contact/SEARCH.md) describes discovery scope.

The exact raw crossing is in **(.00304153116714,.00304153116715)**, tested at .0030415305. Cutoff 17 / floor 18, both inherited rational engines, completion/compiler/BIT stock and all 58 outer predicates pass. A separately written third rational log/exp engine independently proves the decisive signs and recounts the full invoice. The source native phase lowering and complete 265-axis caller are freshly replayed. The independent scalar/funding peer code, retained native compiler/interpreter, negative controls and full receipts are included.

The **five inherited framework premises remain**: native all-column implementation, owned erasure, uniform compiler, precision/tape costs and analytic recovery. The huge uniform word and rounded multiplier are not materialized. This is author-checked conditional research, without independent human/proof-kernel acceptance or selected promotion. The selected record is unchanged.

The package is isolated on canonical main 32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04. Its authenticated 33-file official PR5545 source closure is retained as a dependency capsule; frozen predecessors and shared code are unchanged. No pending Git object or network is needed at runtime. Source attribution is preserved.

Reproduce with Python 3.12/stdlib:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-joint-contact
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-joint-contact --check-source-history
```

Expected markers: `PASS_P104_JOINT_CONTACT_COMPLETE_KAPPA_00304153` and `PASS_PUBLIC_P104_INDEPENDENT_FUNDING`. [VALIDATION.md](https://github.com/thu-nmrc/integer-mult-bounds/blob/codex/p104-joint-contact/research/p104-joint-contact/VALIDATION.md) records executed normal/optimized, source-history, committed-byte and Git-free cold replays. Passing CI is separate from scientific adoption.

Credit Ali Romman (#5544/#5545), Gareth Davidson (#2305), David Arias (#2152), Cinna Davis (#2219/controller), Jacob Alan Sussman, zxv, Cao Yifan and all common-chart, dual-ADD, geometry, native, COPY, precision and analytic predecessors in the retained proofs. Prepared for thu-nmrc with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including parallel subagents; Apache-2.0.

Open next question: independently review the actual six contact sites and complete conditional cost join, preserving the inherited premises. Further frontier improvement needs a different paid path, target contract or caller; refining this crossing alone is not another structural gain.

Hosted CI at exact head 79072da5404a01056df2af2e4132324b01c72366 passed both jobs: [run 40194668767](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40194668767), plan 3m55s and complete registered replay 8m18s, including unchanged committed-input checks. This does not claim maintainer scientific adoption.
